name: duplicati
description: Encrypted backup software with multiple read-only sources and writable destinations

fields.name: DUPLICATI_PORT
fields.label: R1: Web UI Port
fields.help: Host port used to open the Duplicati Web UI.

fields.name: WEB_PASSWORD
fields.label: R2: Web UI Password
fields.help: Password required to sign in to Duplicati. Use Generate to create a strong 48-character value.

fields.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
fields.label: R3: Settings Encryption Key
fields.help:
Protects sensitive values stored in Duplicati's settings database.
Keep a secure copy of this key. Duplicati may be unable to read encrypted settings if it is lost or changed.

fields.name: DATA_LOCATION
fields.label: R4: Duplicati Data Folder
fields.help: Writable host folder for Duplicati configuration and databases.

fields.name: SOURCE_1_LOCATION
fields.label: R5: Backup Source 1
fields.help: Primary host folder containing files to back up. It is mounted read-only at /source/source1, so Duplicati cannot modify the originals.

fields.name: TZ
fields.label: R6: Timezone
fields.help: Timezone used for backup schedules, such as Asia/Dubai or Etc/UTC.

fields.name: DESTINATION_1_MOUNT
fields.label: O1: Local Destination 1
fields.help:
Optional first writable local destination as a complete bind mount.
Example: /volume2/backups:/backups/destination1:rw.
Duplicati must be able to create, change, and delete backup files here. Always keep the :rw suffix. Leave blank when using only a cloud or other remote destination. For meaningful protection, keep backups on different storage from the source data.

fields.name: SOURCE_2_MOUNT
fields.label: O2: Backup Source 2
fields.help:
Optional second source as a complete read-only bind mount.
Example: /volume2/family:/source/source2:ro.
The left side is the NAS folder; Duplicati sees it at /source/source2. Always keep the :ro suffix. Leave blank to omit it.

fields.name: SOURCE_3_MOUNT
fields.label: O3: Backup Source 3
fields.help:
Optional third source as a complete read-only bind mount.
Example: /volume2/mobile-backups:/source/source3:ro.
The left side is the NAS folder; Duplicati sees it at /source/source3. Always keep the :ro suffix. Leave blank to omit it.

fields.name: DESTINATION_2_MOUNT
fields.label: O4: Local Destination 2
fields.help:
Optional second writable local destination as a complete bind mount.
Example: /volume2/backups:/backups/destination2:rw.
Duplicati must be able to create, change, and delete backup files here. Always keep the :rw suffix. Leave blank to omit it.

fields.name: DESTINATION_3_MOUNT
fields.label: O5: Local Destination 3
fields.help:
Optional third writable local destination as a complete bind mount.
Example: /volume3/archive:/backups/destination3:rw.
Duplicati must be able to create, change, and delete backup files here. Always keep the :rw suffix. Leave blank to omit it.

fields.name: ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES
fields.label: O6: Allowed Hostnames
fields.help:
Optional semicolon-separated hostnames used to access Duplicati through DNS or a reverse proxy, for example backup.example.com;duplicati.local.
IP-address access works without this field. Avoid using *, as it disables hostname protection.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: O7: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether the container restarts automatically.

fields.name: DUPLICATI_NETWORK_MODE
fields.label: O8: Network
fields.help: Choose Create New Bridge for the default Compose network, Host Mode for host networking, or an existing named Docker network.

fields.name: DUPLICATI_IMAGE
fields.label: A1: Image
fields.help: Official Duplicati Docker image. Change this only if you need a different tag or image source.

fields.name: DUPLICATI_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: Container Name
fields.help: EasyDocker sets the container name from the project name.

fields.name: DUPLICATI_INTERNAL_PORT
fields.label: Internal Web UI Port
fields.help: Recipe-managed Duplicati Web UI port inside the container.

ui.overview: Duplicati creates encrypted, scheduled backups to local storage and supported remote services.
what_happens: One Duplicati container will be created using the official image
EasyDocker can generate the Web UI password and settings-encryption key
The Duplicati configuration database will be stored in a writable bind-mounted folder
Backup source folders are mounted read-only so Duplicati cannot modify the original files
Optional local backup destinations are mounted read-write so Duplicati can create and maintain backup archives
Additional source and destination mounts are omitted completely when left blank
The container will use the selected Docker networking mode
ui.data_location: Source folders contain the files being protected and should be read-only. Optional local destination folders contain Duplicati backup archives and must be writable; they may all be left blank when using a cloud or other remote destination. Keep the settings encryption key somewhere safe outside this deployment.
